AudioFlamingo2.prompt_provenance: af2_score.py takes --prompt on the command line and records it in neither p14_af2.csv nor logs/p14_af2.log, so this string is not recoverable from the run artifacts. It is the prompt recorded verbatim in the prompt column of the other five PART 14 score files on the same clip list.

yes_rule: p_yes > 0.5 where p_yes = P(Yes)/(P(Yes)+P(No)) at the first answer position
answer_mass: P(Yes)+P(No) at the first answer position; median reported; flagged if < 0.15

bootstrap.paired: one speaker draw per replicate, both arms recomputed inside it

auc_note: no AUC in this task; rule 5 not applicable
folds_note: no cross-validation in this task; rule 7 not applicable
